definitions.explanation: The predetermined course of events in someone's life; what is destined to happen.

examples.japanese: {運命|うんめい}の{出会|であ}いを{信|しん}じますか。
examples.english: Do you believe in fateful encounters?

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}とは{運命|うんめい}だと{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt that meeting her was destiny.

examples.japanese: {運命|うんめい}に{逆|さか}らうことはできない。

notes:
FORMATION:
{運|うん} (luck, fortune) + {命|めい} (life, fate)

USAGE:
・{運命|うんめい}の{人|ひと} (one's destined partner)
・{運命|うんめい}の{出会|であ}い (fateful encounter)
・{運命|うんめい}を{感|かん}じる (to feel destiny)
・{運命|うんめい}に{従|したが}う (to follow one's fate)
・{運命|うんめい}を{切|き}り{開|ひら}く (to carve out one's destiny)
・{運命|うんめい}{共同体|きょうどうたい} (community of shared destiny)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{宿命|しゅくめい} - fate (more predetermined, often negative)
・{天命|てんめい} - heavenly mandate, divine will
・{定|さだ}め - destiny, fate (literary)
